channel.title: Syria Narrative Tracker: weekly digest
channel.description: A weekly written summary of what is being said about Syria online.

item.title: UN Speech Lifts Mood, But Golan and Security Anxieties Persist
item.description: The week was dominated by President al-Sharaa's appearance at the UN General Assembly, which drove a sharp rise in posting volume on 23-24 September (over 1,800 posts each day) and lifted average people tone from -0.35 to -0.07. Outlets framed the diplomatic engagement—including meetings with Trump, Macron, Guterres and Lavrov—overwhelmingly positively (+0.26 to +0.60 across related stories), presenting it as evidence of Syria's international rehabilitation.

item.title: State media touts diplomatic wins as public tone hardens over security incidents
item.description: International relations again led discussion at 30% of the week's stories, though its share fell three points as state media pivoted heavily toward economic and reconstruction messaging (up three points to 20%). Outlets maintained a strongly positive tone throughout (+0.36 to +0.80 across individual stories), framing diplomatic engagement with the US, World Bank, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, France and others, plus the IAEA's closure of Syria's 15-year nuclear non-compliance file, as evidence of growing international legitimacy.
